facts.fact: The ministry's final study of February 2019 proposes a Stratégie Nationale Haut Débit / Plan National du Haut Débit for 2019-2025 (objectives dated 2020 and 2025; coverage of all Moughataas short term and the whole country medium term, with a 623 million US dollar investment estimate over 25 years), and states no adoption by the government or a minister.
